name: David Grusch
quote: This is also a real fraud, waste and abuse issue — slush funds to the tune of billions of dollars per annum. It's a continuum from corporeal bipedal type life to... sentient plasma life.

name: Luis Elizondo
quote: The phenomenon is real. The question is, what is it? We have an intelligence failure on our hands. There are things in our skies that we can't explain, and we owe it to the American people to be transparent.

name: Chuck Schumer
role: US Senator (D-NY) / UAP Disclosure Act Author
quote: The American public has a right to learn about technologies of unknown origin, non-human intelligence, and unexplainable phenomena. We are not only combating the stigma — we are also seeking the truth.

name: Marco Rubio
role: US Senator (R-FL) / Former Senate Intel Vice Chair
quote: There are people who have come forward to share information with our committee who have claimed to have direct personal knowledge of programs. I don't want to be reckless with this but I will say — some of these people have held very high clearances and high positions.

name: Tim Burchett
quote: I want to thank President Trump for keeping his word on transparency. I would like to remind people that transparency won't all happen at once — it will take some time. But the PURSUE release is a start.

name: Sean Kirkpatrick
quote: To date, AARO has not discovered any verifiable information to substantiate claims that any programs regarding the possession or reverse-engineering of extraterrestrial materials have existed or currently exist.

name: David Fravor
role: Retired Navy Commander / Nimitz Encounter Pilot
quote: I think it was not from this world. I'm not crazy, and I wasn't drunk. It was a real object, it existed in space, it was there, I saw it with my own eyes, and it was tracked on multiple sensor systems. It was not any technology that I'm aware of.

name: Ryan Graves
role: Former Navy F/A-18F Pilot / Americans for Safe Aerospace Founder
quote: These are real objects that exist in our airspace, and the stigma attached to them is real and powerful and challenges our ability to deal with them. If UAPs are foreign drones, it's an urgent national security problem. If they're something else, it's a scientific opportunity.

name: Kirsten Gillibrand
quote: We need full transparency. My goal is to require the Pentagon to either confirm or deny these programs exist. The American people and Congress deserve answers, and we will not stop until we get them.

name: Donald Trump
quote: The American public has a right to know about these things. The PURSUE program is releasing what we know. The public can make up their own minds.

name: Anna Paulina Luna
role: US Representative (R-FL) / House Oversight Task Force Chair
quote: I have seen evidence in a SCIF that leads me to believe there are things we cannot explain. I have observed things that are of nonhuman origin and creation. Tranche 1 is a step forward, but the 46 whistleblower-identified videos must come in Tranche 2 — and I will hold them accountable.

name: Eric Burlison
quote: It was difficult to get that in there. We had to fight staffers, really staffers, people that are unelected, who kept throwing every excuse in the book.

name: Avi Loeb
role: Harvard Astrophysicist / Chair, White House UAP Science Advisory Council
quote: A good detective resolves mysteries by collecting new evidence and analyzing it, rather than by discussing the unknown on social media or asking AI for help.
